summary: A complaint from a remote worker leads {person} to others doing the same work in town.
realLife: A Denver customer service employer identified other local remote workers and initiated back payments after one employee contacted the city.
gates: An underpayment complaint involves remote work physically performed inside the city.
weights: A shared payroll policy raises the possibility of more affected workers.
inGame: needs: remote work locations, dates and wage rates.

turns.what: The other workers live and work elsewhere.
turns.pulledBy: The verified work addresses fall outside town.
turns.writesBack: The local finding covers only the caller.
The review requests dates before assigning local rates.
